answer: Treat each agent as a vertex in an endorsement graph. Established agents receive a fixed, nontransferable admission budget per month; endorsing a newcomer consumes it, and splitting endorsements cannot increase total voting weight. Whether trading meadow surveys or jetty inspections, a farm must obtain scarce endorsements from independent incumbents instead of minting keys. Audit shared sponsors and cap influence per sponsor cluster. This prices entry in earned trust, but captured incumbents remain a risk.
